(The figure shows two groups of plant cells. Group A cells are plump and turgid, with cytoplasm pressed against the cell walls. Group B cells are shrunken, with the cytoplasm pulled away from the cell walls — plasmolysed.)

options.label: A
options.text: A - Turgid plant cell; B - plasmolysed plant cell. A will shrink up and B will swell and regain the size.

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.text: A - plasmolysed cell; B - turgid plant cell. A will shrink up and B will swell and regain the original shape.
